properties.title: Extreme learning machine and bayesian optimization-driven intelligent framework for IoMT cyber-attack detection

properties.name: ELM with Bayesian hyperparameter optimization
properties.healthcare_intended_scope: IoMT security; evaluated ToN_IoT network traces, not patient dynamics
properties.architecture: 42 network features -> random hidden layer -> pseudoinverse fitted output weights -> attack class; BO selects activation/hidden-neuron count/alpha.

scope.time_horizon: Independent static network labels; no health-world forecast

assertions.applicability_reason: Evaluated independent network-attack classification has no propagated health-world state, temporal/action transition, forecast trajectory, clinical action/counterfactual, WM-planner or operational agent. BO models hyperparameter-score surface, not healthcare dynamics. Cited temporal/RL systems are other authors work.
